name: 25th Winthrop Christmas Tree Lighting and Holiday Market
ages: All ages, family, kid and pet friendly
paras: Winthrop marks 25 years of its community Christmas tree lighting on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM. The tree stands on Winthrop Common near the Mulberry Trees in Riverview, with a holiday market set up around the Common.

The lighting itself starts with a countdown, and Santa lights the tree. Santa also visits during the evening, and a kids games area keeps younger guests busy between the performances and the food and drink vendors.

Students from Symmes Elementary, Buckhorn Elementary, Children's Kastle and Winthrop College Preparatory take the community stage, along with groups from local music and dance studios. The Winthrop Pop Up Market brings more than 100 local and seasonal vendors, and over seven Winthrop restaurants are open before, during and after the event.
Admission is free, and the event welcomes families, kids and pets.
tip: Eat at a Winthrop restaurant before the countdown, then walk the market around the Common.

name: Gingerbread Bash Parents Night Out at First Baptist Brandon
paras: First Baptist Church Brandon runs a Parents Night Out called the Gingerbread Bash on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 6 to 8 PM. Children from babies through 5th grade are invited, and parents drop them off for the evening.

The kids Group at the church plans games, a Christmas craft, dinner and dessert. The church describes it as a night packed with holiday cheer, so families can use the two hours for a date night or Christmas shopping.
The price is $10 per child, and parents register through the church's events page. The church office is reachable at 813-689-1204.
tip: Register through the church events page before the night, since drop off needs the child's details on file.

name: He Has Come Christmas Musical at First Baptist Brandon
when_note: Saturday, December 12 and Sunday, December 13, 5 to 7 PM
paras: First Baptist Church Brandon presents the He Has Come Christmas musical on two evenings, Saturday, December 12 and Sunday, December 13, 2026, each from 5 to 7 PM.

The program pairs a choir with a live orchestra, a youth choir and a children's choir, so young singers share the stage with the full church choir. The church calls it a Christmas celebration built around the story of the first Christmas.
Registration lists the price as free. Guests can choose a performance and sign up on the church's event page, which also asks how many people are attending and whether children are coming.
tip: Pick the Saturday or Sunday performance when you register, since each evening has its own sign up page.
